Subject: Project timeline update: new date 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the project timeline. Our team has already adjusted the internal plan around this new date, and the remaining workstreams are on track to proceed without further delay once certification is complete. We are keeping close contact with the vendor to monitor progress and will flag immediately if anything changes on their end.

Would it work for you if we scheduled a short call this week to walk through the revised plan and confirm the new date fits with your own downstream commitments?

Best regards,
[Your Name]
